mainText: Hey Verona, let's get into the dish! We are absolutely sizzling at 92 degrees with clear skies over Verona Area High School, and tonight is perfect for stargazing with a waxing crescent moon and a spectacular five-minute space station flyover starting at 9:30 PM!
Get ready to turn your kitchen scraps into gold because Verona is highlighting cool composting options for apartment dwellers, including dropping off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop!
We have an amazing weekend lined up, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard on Friday, July 17th, and the gorgeous Mount Horeb Art Fair on Saturday, July 18th, so get out there and enjoy!
On Thursday, July 10th, the Verona Police Department's superstar canine Drea was on fire, sniffing out drugs during a couple of evening traffic stops that led to arrests!
You deserve a treat, so run over to Culver's for today's mouthwatering Snickers Swirl, packed with candy goodness, before they close up at 10:30 PM!
